s: hand-drip coffee on the former site of a Joseon-era herbal medicine dispensary
w: Down a narrow Euljiro alley, this café takes its name -- "herbal medicine shop" -- from the building's past as Hyeminseo, a Joseon Dynasty medical office. The signature filter coffee is fire-roasted and hand-dripped, served in a space that keeps the traditional, slightly hidden character of the building rather than smoothing it into something more generic.
_facts: Located at 16-6 Samil-daero 12-gil, Jung District, Seoul, near Euljiro 3-ga Station Exit 6
Occupies the former site of Hyeminseo, a Joseon Dynasty-era public medical dispensary
"Hanyakbang" translates to herbal medicine shop/traditional Korean medicine dispensary
Known for fire-roasted, hand-drip filter coffee
Has a second branch in Hyehwa

s: an award-winning roaster's showroom in a quiet Apgujeong side street
w: The Seoul outpost of a Hanam-based roaster, set over two floors of a converted single-family house on a quiet Apgujeong alley of villas and apartments. Winner of the 2023 Korean Barista Award for Best Coffee Bar, with in-house roasted beans and homemade baking backed by enough working equipment on display to feel active rather than decorative.
_facts: Located at 23 Eonju-ro 167-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, on the road between Apgujeong Station and Rodeo Street
Seoul branch of Bunker Company, a roaster based in Hanam
Winner of the 2023 Korean Barista Award for Best Coffee Bar
Set across the 1st and 2nd floors of a converted house

s: a Ghibli-inspired café built around a blue acorn character
w: A whimsical café near Anguk Station built around a Studio Ghibli-adjacent aesthetic and a blue acorn mascot, its cabinets full of acorn-shaped madeleines in flavours like black sesame and pistachio alongside Greek yoghurt bowls. A gentle, fairy-tale-styled pause on the walk between Bukchon's hanok streets.
_facts: Located at 19-8 Gyedong-gil, Jongno District, Seoul, about 200m from Anguk Station Exit 3
Studio Ghibli-inspired café theme, built around a blue acorn character
Known for acorn-shaped madeleines and other themed baked goods
